description: Helium chapter (2 pp.) of the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024: 2023 salient statistics - estimated Grade-A price about $14 per cubic meter ($390 per thousand cubic feet), management of the Federal Helium System transferred from BLM to GSA on December 3, 2022, the two-lot sale of the system in progress with bids accepted until January 23, 2024, and the September 7, 2023 lawsuit against the sale resolved November 2, 2023 in favour of proceeding.

notes: One chapter of a larger annual publication; DOI 10.3133/mcs2024 identifies the whole Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024. This is the year the price series doubled: about $14/m3 for 2023 against $7.57/m3 for 2021 in MCS 2022, 'with some producers posting surcharges to this price'. 2023 data are marked estimated ('e'). Lifting gas was 16% of 2023 US apparent consumption (59 Mm3) here, against 18% of 56 Mm3 in MCS 2025 - the share moves year to year.
